title: Apple (AAPL) Receives Coverage Optimism Score of -2.14
text:
News headlines about Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) have been trending negative this week, according to InfoTrie. InfoTrie identifies positive and negative media coverage by monitoring more than 6,000 news and blog sources. public negative five to five, with scores nearest Apple earned a daily sentiment score of -2.14 gave headlines about the iPhone maker an news buzz score of 1 out of 10, meaning that recent media coverage is extremely unlikely to have an impact on the company’s share price in the near term.
These are some of the headlines that may have effected Apple’s analysis:
Get Apple alerts: Switzerland says Apple pledges to fix disruptions to rival payment app (feeds.reuters.com) Ron Lessard’s Newly Released “A Candle Glows” Is a Thrilling Sleuth Novel Featuring Twelve-Year-Old Twins, a Rumor, an Old House, and Stolen Wealth From Bavarian Royalty (prweb.com) Joseph C. E. Warnes’s Newly Released “Workable Project Management Procedures for Disaster Reconstruction” Is an Instructive Guide for Project Managers (prweb.com) T.J. Fisher’s Newly Released “More an Echo Than a Sound” Is a Riveting Tale of a Man’s Search for His Life’s Purpose and the Idea of True Spirituality (prweb.com) Google Details Major New York Expansion (wsj.com) A number of analysts have commented on AAPL shares. New Street Research downgraded Apple from a “neutral” rating to a “sell” rating in a research report on Monday, August 20th. Wells Fargo & Co set a $210.00 price objective on Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a research report on Monday, August 20th. Macquarie set a $214.00 price objective on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Tuesday, August 21st. Bank of America reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $250.00 price objective (up previously from $230.00) on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, August 21st. Finally, Morgan Stanley reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $232.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, August 22nd. Three investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have issued a hold rating and twenty-four have assigned a buy rating to the company’s stock. The stock has an average rating of “Hold” and an average price target of $222.77.
Shares of AAPL opened at $163.94 on Tuesday. Apple has a 1 year low of $150.24 and a 1 year high of $233.47. The company has a quick ratio of 1.09, a current ratio of 1.12 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87. The company has a market capitalization of $813.36 billion, a PE ratio of 13.76, a P/E/G ratio of 1.19 and a beta of 1.21.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. Apple had a return on equity of 48.68% and a net margin of 22.41%. The business had revenue of $62.90 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $61.55 billion. During the same period in the prior year, the firm posted $2.07 EPS. Apple’s quarterly revenue was up 19.6% compared to the same quarter last year. As a group, equities research analysts expect that Apple will post 13.33 earnings per share for the current year.
In related news, insider Luca Maestri sold 100,245 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction on Thursday, October 4th. The stock was sold at an average price of $228.56, for a total transaction of $22,911,997.20. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now directly owns 91,665 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $20,950,952.40. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available at the SEC website . Also, SVP Angela J. Ahrendts sold 25,000 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction on Wednesday, October 3rd. The shares were sold at an average price of $232.66, for a total value of $5,816,500.00. Following the sale, the senior vice president now directly owns 105,538 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $24,554,471.08. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold a total of 204,845 shares of company stock valued at $47,015,677 over the last ninety days. Insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock.
